scope: A06 only; fixed 38980 English articles; no minimum words, no exclusions or deduplication

heading.unicode_normalization: NFKC + casefold + curved apostrophe U+2019 to ASCII
heading.match: exact normalized heading or text before first colon; other preserved; all h1-h6 including widget headings already retained by T02

calibration.selection: six per proposed recognized class,30 other; min hash42:A06-calibration:article:heading; year and ID hidden; not representative
calibration.role: single operator lexical-function annotation; no population accuracy claim

sequence.primary: all headings in order, repeated functions and other retained; no_heading separate
sequence.auxiliary: recognized-only sequence, no_recognized_heading distinct from no_heading
sequence.top10: annual adaptive top10 frequency; all/headed and heading count bands separately; separately frozen main-year discovery top10 evaluated in holdout

resampling.mode: without replacement per year to min-year article n, independently within each scope/heading band; mean and percentile95 range of statistic, not population CI

positions.domain: saved ASCII S=P+L+U words in clean DOM order; H text excluded
positions.pre_heading: S words strictly before first saved heading; no heading=>NA, headed with zero S=>0 raw words / NA share
positions.closing: last heading classified closing; section ends before next heading of same or higher level, including nested subsections; not necessarily last semantic section
positions.closing_zero_absent: no closing heading=>0 words; zero-absent share W_S=0=>NA
positions.closing_conditional: no closing heading=>NA, present zero words=>0; conditional mean and coverage separately

edges.domain: saved P word tokens; first50 and last50 or all if fewer; overlap max(0,2*min(50,W_P)-W_P)
edges.boundaries: owner,source unit,sentence,nonword token,window boundary; punctuation not separate barrier; extracted adjacency may cross removed inline code
edges.fold: reuse immutable A04 author/exact nonempty P components; never reassign

discovery.rank: annual-equal article presence difference, positive and negative separately; descending absolute delta then n ascending and lexical term
discovery.eligibility: pooled main six years, discovery only; zero P retained in prevalence denominator
discovery.zero_or_fewer: no threshold relaxation; keep zero eligible if applicable

edges.holdout: freeze candidate IDs and terms before reading holdout edge gram counts; same/opposite/zero and missing separately; no reselection
edges.diagnostics: known exact P hashes, top1/top5 authors and component occurrence share; series metadata observed when available, no inferential series classifier

bootstrap.interval: percentile95 linear; all known authors across years for structural proxies, holdout A04 components for frozen phrase prevalence; exploratory non-simultaneous

quality: preserve unknown/widget headings, exact duplicates and short texts; no quality/AI/causal inference
